main_text.p: Sessio Christi ad d. D. P. est summus gradus exaltationis Christi, dum evectus in sacerdotio & regno suo in cœlesti sacrario est perpetuus noster Pontifex, & omnem potestatem in res creatas universas in cœlo & in terra possidet, ut per ipsum pater omnia immediate agat & gubernet. (Vide Sedere).
4. Spiritus S. Deus sedere dicitur Act.2.3.
5. Sedet Angelus S. Matth.28.2 Marc.16 5. Ioann.20. 12, Apoc.6.2. & 14.v.14,15.16.
6. Ecclesia militans, Cantic. 2. 3. Esai. 52.2. Mich. 7,8, Zach.14,11, Matth.4,16, Luc.1.79, Triumphans, Matth.19, 28. Luc.22.30. Apoc.3.21. & 4.4. & 11.16, & 20,4.

7. Sedent homines mortales in terra, provocationum suarum ratione, ut patresfamilias, hospitales viri, convivæ, peregrini, quiescentes, iudices, principes, reges, subditi, pauperes, divites, afflicti, senes, viri, fœminæ: de quibus ducenta testimonia in Scripturis occurrunt.
8. Sedet Angelus malus, summi iudicis Lictor & carnifex, Apoc.6.v.4 5. & 9,17.
9. Sedet Antichristus, qui & meretrix mystica, 2, Thess.2,4 Apoc.17.v.1.9,15,& 18,7.

Sedes, de Deo, item de Patre, de Deo Filio, de hominibus, de bestia, de Satana dicitur.1.de Deo, Psalm 11, 4.& 47.9. & 89.15. & 93 2.& 103 19. Esai.66.1. Actor.7.49. Apocal.22 1. 2. Sedes Dei Patris, Hebr. 8. 1, & 12 2, Apocal. 4. verfic. 2. &c. & 14. 3. 3. Dei filij, nempe Christi, regis Ecclesiæ Psal.45. 7. & 89. 5. & 97. 2 Matth.19.28. & 25.31. 4. Hominis, Iosu. 22 8.Iudic.9, 15, Psalm. 94. 20. & 122. 5. & 132. v. 11. 1. Lucæ. 1. ver. 32, 52.Act.2 30.5. Piorum in cœlis, Matt.19.28. Apo. 11,16,& 20.4.6

page.notes: The right margin notes are too faint and cut off to transcribe reliably. The heading "Sessio" is set with an enlarged initial S. The "[?]" marks are not needed as the text was readable; the ligature and spacing of the lower lines are uncertain.
